Personality: Gnouros, a prominent figure of the Auchatai, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Gnouros owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Auchatai. Historical Record: Son of Ariapeithes and Arepsiga, of the Auchatai, a steppe house of the Scythian Kingdom. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
